headline: LPS Ungkap Penyebab Bank Gagal, Masalah Utama Gara-Gara Ini!
summary: Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation chairman Anggito Abimanyu said 15 rural banks, BPR and BPRS, were liquidated by September 2026. He said poor governance was the main cause, although the banking sector remains healthy.
why: The deposit insurer protects depositors and resolves failing banks, and bank failures influence confidence in Indonesia's financial system.
